blocks.p: About this copy: Public domain text: Dante’s poem, completed about 1320, in Henry Wadsworth Longfellow’s blank-verse translation of 1867. Transcribed from Project Gutenberg eBook #1004 and converted to Markdown; the Gutenberg boilerplate, the table of contents and the appendix of Longfellow’s six sonnets on the Divine Comedy were removed, the canto summaries from that table are folded into the canto headings, and the original spelling and punctuation are kept. Longfellow’s single footnote, his English rendering of Arnaut Daniel’s Provençal speech in Purgatorio XXVI, is kept in italics at the end of that canto; the tercets are printed flush left without the source’s indentation.
